items.title: The stalk of the structure sheaf in the etale topology is the strict henselization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the stalk of the structure sheaf on the small etale site with the strict henselization of the local ring, in the form of a canonical identification of the two filtered colimits over etale neighbourhoods (statement lines 4256-4279, whose slogan line is excluded from the counted spans as explained in the notes). The proof writes both objects as filtered colimits over etale neighbourhoods of the geometric point (proof lines 4281-4295) and identifies them because the index categories and transition maps coincide (proof lines 4295-4309). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two colimit descriptions. The claim is H2: one comparison of colimits.
